# Purple Owl

Purple Owl is a purple dark theme that the description blends from the Night Owl and Minimal aesthetics. It uses MonoLisa and local mac fonts as primary fallbacks and preserves the Night Owl color palette for high-contrast, readable notes.

![Purple Owl screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacharyc/purple-owl-theme/HEAD/purple-owl-theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Purple Owl"
    author: "zacharyc"
    repo:   "zacharyc/purple-owl-theme"
    slug:   "purple-owl"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/purple-owl"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/zacharyc/purple-owl-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacharyc/purple-owl-theme/HEAD/purple-owl-theme.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a purple Night Owl–inspired dark theme that blends Night Owl and Minimal aesthetics for Obsidian. Use MonoLisa and local mac fonts as primary fallbacks and preserve Night Owl’s color palette for high-contrast, readable notes."
}
```
